text:
**Change:** The ERC requires every nfet bulk to connect to `vss`, so I tied the M1/M2 bulks to `vss` instead of `tail`.

**Effect of the body bias:** The input pair now sees a small source-to-bulk voltage. Its threshold rises by about 30–60 mV, and its source sits around 0.25–0.35 V at mid-rail common mode.

**Tail headroom:** The tail sink is wide (W=120, L=3, m=2 at 20 µA), so its Vdsat stays below about 0.15 V. It should stay saturated even at ss / −40 °C / 1.62 V.

**Gain and bandwidth:** These are set by the differential gm, which the body effect barely changes. I left all other sizes unchanged.

**Not verified:** I have not simulated this revision, so I have not confirmed that every spec still passes across corners. The tightest margins to watch are tail headroom at ss / −40 °C / 1.62 V, phase margin, and settling time.

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference diode (10 uA)
MN0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=120 L=3
* tail current source (20 uA)
MN5 tail ibias vss vss nfet W=120 L=3 m=2
* NMOS input pair, bulk tied to vss (p-substrate)
M1 n1d vinn tail vss nfet W=320 L=1
M2 out1 vinp tail vss nfet W=320 L=1
* PMOS mirror load (10 uA each)
M3 n1d n1d vdd vdd pfet W=16 L=2
M4 out1 n1d vdd vdd pfet W=16 L=2
* second stage: PMOS CS (60 uA), NMOS sink mirrored 6x
M6 vout out1 vdd vdd pfet W=96 L=2
MN7 vout ibias vss vss nfet W=120 L=3 m=6
* Miller compensation with LHP-zero resistor
Rz out1 nz 3.3k
Cc nz vout 7p
.ends
```
